description: Presidential Secretariat - Establishing the National Salaries & Cadre Commission for a period of 02 years Commencing from 03.03.2016 & Appointing K.L.L. Wijeratne Esquire as the Chairman & Asoka Jayasekare Esquire as the Secretary & 22 other members
categorisation: This gazette establishes a Special Agency/Salaries and Cadre Commission through a Presidential Directive. It names 23 specific individuals (K. L. L. Wijeratne, Nimal Bandara, etc.) who are being appointed to this commission AND provides detailed descriptions of their responsibilities, including reviewing remuneration structures, formulating national wage policy, conducting cadre assessments, making recommendations on salary structures for various sectors, and addressing public service management systems. The content contains both "who" (named individuals) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
